title: Eclipse
line: My own development, AI and automation studio, built as one complete system: a landing page that sells with demos, two portals and its own backend.

facts.v: Product, design and engineering, end to end
Landing · client portal · backend · internal portal · email kit

film.alt: A walk through the Eclipse landing page: the animated eclipse in the hero, then services, small businesses and demos.
film.label: Live landing page

ten.v: A small business lets inquiries, bookings and follow-ups slip away, and buys software once it sees its own business working.
A landing page that shows their industry in a demo first; behind it, my own system takes the request to a project in five stages.
The landing page is live at eclipse-business.com; the connected portal, the backend and the internal portal are built and tested.

how.d: Real estate leads the way, with a demo and published plans.
Lumen Propiedades, a fictional real estate agency with chatbot, pipeline, viewings and follow-ups.
On WhatsApp, with the chosen plan already in the message.
A written proposal; the project is born with the deposit, in one transaction.
The client sees it in their portal, in five stages, from preparation to delivery.

decisions.t: The browser sends only the selection
decisions.why: The API recomputes the estimate in cents from a frozen catalog; a test requires it to match the website on 183 selections.

decisions.t: Projects are born with a deposit
decisions.why: Accepting a request records a decision; a deferred PostgreSQL trigger requires a collected deposit, even for SQL written outside the application.
The demo is published on GitHub Pages with zero network calls; the connected version lives on the API's domain, where the cookies travel.

landing-proceso.caption: How we work and FAQ: the process, then one answer unfolds.

more.p: Four repos, one product. The websites are static and send everything through my own API in Node and Express, with PostgreSQL via Prisma: 117 operations, 28 models and separate sessions for clients and administration.

Session in HttpOnly cookies and the CSRF token in memory; passwords with Argon2id; a refresh token that rotates on every use; administrators only in the server's environment, with TOTP; every client query filters by owner or member.

CI in every repo. On 28/10/2026 I ran all three suites: 463 tests on the website, 779 on the backend and 132 on the internal portal. The website deploys with a backup, smoke checks and automatic rollback.

next: Next step: deploy the backend, complete through phase 9, and open the connected portal.
